title: Baghel Singh Marches On and Warnings Are Ignored

blocks.text: Baghel Singh dismisses fearful calculations with a soldier's realism. Nobody vacated an occupied territory without a fight, he argues, so recovery can come only by marching forward and accepting battle rather than by wishful negotiation.
The confrontation accordingly becomes unavoidable. Baghel Singh orders his force to march towards Patiala, while Amar Singh reacts in anger and presses his advisers toward immediate action.

One voice still counsels caution, warning that the Singhs should not be treated lightly, yet hawkish chiefs brush such advice aside. The page ends with pride overpowering prudence and the clash drawing visibly nearer.
